开源 TOP 项目：懒人工程师提示词让智能体少写代码。 这个仓库 🦥 想让 AI.zh: 开源 TOP 项目：懒人工程师提示词让智能体少写代码。 这个仓库 🦥 想让 AI 智能体像屋里最懒的资深工程师那样思考，主张最好的代码就是没写出来的代码。它在 懒人编程提示词集 里已攒下 12.9万星 ，单日再涨 1539 颗，Fork 数 6902。装进编码智能体后，它会先劝你删掉多余实现。想整治屎山代码的团队可以直接抄作业。 一个命令行让智能体读完整个互联网。 Agent-Reach 给智能体 👀 装上读全网的眼睛，Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B站和小红书都能搜。这个 全网读取命令行工具 不收 API 费用，已收获 8.1万星 ，单日新增 640 颗。它把各家平台收敛成一条命令。想省掉爬虫和密钥的团队可以直接接上。 开源 AI 代理集合项目揽星十五万七千。 这个仓库 👥 把整支 AI 代理团队塞了进来，从前端开发到社区运营各有专长。这个 开源智能体集合仓库 已收获 15.7万星 ，单日新增 595 颗。每个代理都带自己的流程与交付物。装好就能上手，省掉自己搭流程的工夫。 开源智能体视频系统带十二条流水线。 OpenMontage 自称首个开源 🎬 的智能体视频生产系统，塞进 12 条生产流水线、100 多个工具和 700 多份技能文件。它把这个 开源视频生产系统 挂到编码助手上，已拿到 5.8万星 ，单日涨 383 颗。装上之后，编码助手就变成一间视频工作室。分镜、素材和成片都在同一套流程里跑。 生产级工程技能打包给编码智能体。 agent-skills 🛠️ 把生产环境里的工程技能整理成包，供给 AI 编码智能体直接调用。这套 生产级工程技能库 已收获 9.4万星 ，单日新增 354 颗，Fork 数一万。它补的是智能体缺的工程规矩，不是又一个新模型。想让智能体少犯低级错的团队可以先装这套。 一套设计语言让智能体审美跟上来。 impeccable 🎨 是一份写给 AI 智能体的设计语言，目标是让编码助手的产出更懂审美。这个 智能体设计语言仓库 已攒下 7万星 ，单日又涨 287 颗，Fork 数 4259。它管的是配色、间距和层级这些模型最容易糊弄的地
开源 TOP 项目：懒人工程师提示词让智能体少写代码。 这个仓库 🦥 想让 AI.en: Top open-source projects: A 'lazy engineer' prompt encourages agents to write less code. This repository 🦥 asks AI agents to think like the laziest senior engineer in the room: the best code is the code you never write. Its lazy-programming prompt collection has 129,000 stars, with 1,539 added in a day and 6,902 forks. Once installed in a coding agent, it first encourages you to remove unnecessary implementations. Teams tackling messy codebases can use it as a reference. One command line lets an agent read across the internet. Agent-Reach gives agents 👀 eyes across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu. This web-reading command-line tool charges no API fees and has 81,000 stars, with 640 added in a day. It brings those platforms together under one command. Teams wanting to save work on crawlers and keys can connect it. An open-source AI-agent collection reaches 157,000 stars. This repository 👥 packages an entire team of AI agents, each with expertise from frontend development to community operations. The collection has 157,000 stars, with 595 added in a day. Each agent brings its own workflow and deliverables, ready to use without building everything yourself. An open-source agentic video system offers twelve pipelines. OpenMontage calls itself the first open-source 🎬 agentic video-production system, with 12 pipelines, more than 100 tools, and more than 700 skill files. Connected to a coding assistant, this system has 58,000 stars and added 383 in a day. The coding assistant becomes a video studio, handling storyboards, assets, and finished videos in one workflow. Production engineering skills packaged for coding agents. agent-skills 🛠️ organizes production engineering skills for direct use by coding agents. This library has 94,000 stars, with 354 added in a day and 10,000 forks. It supplies engineering discipline agents lack, not another model. Teams wanting fewer basic agent mistakes can try it. A design language helps improve agents' aesthetic judgment. impeccable 🎨 is a design language for AI agents, intended to improve coding assistants' design output. The repository has 70,000 stars, with 287 added in a day and 4,259 forks. It covers color, spacing, and hierarchy—the areas models often gloss over… [captured excerpt ends here]
